name: Google NotebookLM (Gemini Notebook)
why_listed: People who want PDFs, articles and YouTube videos turned into AI podcast-style Audio Overviews, summaries and Q&A, and shared as a notebook with collaborators, would use NotebookLM instead of Spoken Margins.

platforms.detail: Full product in the browser; mobile apps for iPhone/iPad and Android phones and tablets with a reduced feature set.

sources.title: Get started with the Gemini Notebook mobile app - iPhone & iPad - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: The Gemini Notebook mobile app is available on iPhones and iPads with iOS 17 and higher.

sources.title: Get started with the Gemini Notebook mobile app - Android - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: On Android, the Gemini Notebook mobile app is available on phones and tablets, running Android 10 and up.

sources.title: Upgrade Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: Gemini Notebook is available in browser to all users above the age of consent

platforms.note: NotebookLM now appears as 'Gemini Notebook' on Google's help center and App Store (same app id 6737527615 and help URLs under /notebooklm/). notebooklm.google now redirects to notebook.google (checked 2026-09-28).

price_free_tier.value: Free with a Google account: 100 notebooks, 50 sources per notebook, 50 chats/day, 3 Audio Overviews/day
price_free_tier.detail: The standard tier is free; limits moved to compute-based 5-hour windows from 2026-09-02, so per-feature numbers are 'subject to change'.

sources.title: Upgrade Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: Sign up free of charge by using your gmail account.

sources.title: Upgrade Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: Notebooks 100/user 200/user 500/user 500/user 500/user Sources 50/notebook

price_free_tier.note: The limits table on the upgrade page is labelled 'Usage Limits (Subject to Change)'.

price_paid.value: Google AI Plus: USD 4.99 (US App Store in-app purchase; period not shown). Google AI Pro: USD 19.99/month or 199.99/year
price_paid.detail: Higher limits come through Google AI plans (Plus, Pro, Ultra), Workspace or Google Cloud; there is no NotebookLM-only plan.

sources.title: Gemini Notebook App - App Store
sources.quote: Google AI Plus (400 GB) $4.99

sources.title: Google AI plans with Cloud Storage - Google One
sources.quote: Monthly ($19.99) Annual ($199.99)

sources.title: Upgrade Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: higher limits and more features through Google AI Plans , Google Cloud , or a qualifying Google Workspace plan

price_paid.note: US App Store and US Google One page, USD. The Google One page did not render the Plus price in static HTML; the $4.99 figure is from the App Store in-app purchase list, which also lists Plus at $49.99 (likely annual) and may reflect an introductory price.

plays_podcasts.detail: Not a podcast player. Local audio files can be uploaded as sources (transcribed to text); there is no feed subscription. Its own Audio Overviews are generated, not subscribed.

sources.title: Get started with the Gemini Notebook mobile app - iPhone & iPad - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: Only PDF, Website, YouTube, Audio, or Copied Text are supported as source types.

plays_podcasts.note: Source-type list in the help center treated as comprehensive.

reads_web_articles_aloud.detail: Audio Overviews turn web sources into an AI-hosted discussion or a single-speaker brief; this is a generated summary, not a verbatim reading.

sources.title: Generate Audio Overview in Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: Audio Overviews are deep-dive discussions between AI hosts that provide in-depth summaries of the key topics in your uploaded sources.

sources.title: Generate Audio Overview in Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: A single speaker delivers the key takeaways of a document in under two minutes.

reads_web_articles_aloud.note: No verbatim text-to-speech of an article was found.

reads_pdfs_aloud.detail: Same as articles: PDFs can be sources for Audio Overviews (generated discussion), not read verbatim.

sources.title: Gemini Notebook App - App Store
sources.quote: Upload all your long and complex PDFs, websites, YouTube videos, or text into a notebook.

sources.title: Generate Audio Overview in Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: Audio Overviews are deep-dive discussions between AI hosts that provide in-depth summaries of the key topics in your uploaded sources.

voice_notes_anchored.detail: The mobile app can record audio, which becomes a transcribed source; notes are notebook-level text, not tied to a point in a source.

sources.title: Gemini Notebook App - App Store
sources.quote: Voice Recorder - You can now record audio directly within the mobile app.

sources.title: Add or discover new sources for your notebook - Computer - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: The audio file is transcribed at the time of import and its text is saved to use as a new source.

voice_notes_anchored.note: Inferred from the notes help page (notes are written or saved chat responses) plus the release note; recorded audio is treated as a source.

text_notes_anchored.detail: Notes are written in the Studio panel or saved from chat; they belong to the notebook, not to a passage or timestamp. Chat answers cite sources inline.

sources.title: Create & add notes in Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: In the “Studio” panel in the “Notes” section, select Add note . You can write or paste text into this note.

sources.title: Create & add notes in Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: The Gemini Notebook mobile app does not support this feature at this time.

text_notes_anchored.note: The notes help page describes only these two ways to create notes; inline citations link AI answers, not user notes, to source passages.

hands_free_capture.detail: No headphone, Watch, lock-screen or CarPlay capture found. Audio Overviews play in the background, and Live Voice lets you talk to a notebook.

sources.title: Get started with the Gemini Notebook mobile app - iPhone & iPad - Gemini Notebook Help
Gemini Notebook App - App Store

hands_free_capture.note: Checked the mobile-app help page and App Store description/version history; background playback exists but no capture gesture is described.

transcripts.detail: Uploaded audio files and YouTube captions are turned into text sources; there are no podcast feeds, and no transcript view of an Audio Overview was found.

sources.title: Add or discover new sources for your notebook - Computer - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: The audio file is transcribed at the time of import and its text is saved to use as a new source.

sources.title: Add or discover new sources for your notebook - Computer - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: Only the text transcript of the video is imported as a source.

ai_summaries.detail: Summaries of all sources in chat, reports, study guides, mind maps, Audio and Video Overviews.

sources.title: Create a notebook in Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: The “Chat” panel displays a generated summary of all your sources.

export_markdown_pkm.detail: Notes and reports export to Google Docs or Sheets; no Markdown, Obsidian, Notion or Readwise export is documented.

sources.title: Create & add notes in Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: You can export your notes to Google Docs or Google Sheets.

sources.title: Gemini Notebook App - App Store
sources.quote: Users can now view, download, and share .jpg, .png, .md, and .txt files created in the desktop Gemini Notebook app.

export_markdown_pkm.note: Only Google Docs/Sheets export is documented; the .md mention refers to generated files viewable on mobile, not a notes export.

share_note_at_moment.detail: Sharing is of a whole notebook (or a chat view link); there is no per-note link that opens a source at a moment.

sources.title: Create a notebook in Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: You can grant “Viewer” or “Editor” access to another user by adding their email address.

share_note_at_moment.note: Inferred from the notebook sharing and notes help pages, which describe no per-note or timestamp link.

group_listening.detail: Notebooks can be shared with up to 50 people (personal accounts); editors' note edits sync in real time. Not group listening or passage-level annotation.

sources.title: Create a notebook in Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: Personal Gmail accounts can share a notebook with up to 50 users but can't share with Google Groups.

sources.title: Create & add notes in Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: Note edits sync in real-time for all collaborators in the same open notebook.

on_device_privacy.detail: A cloud AI service that requires a Google account; sources are uploaded to Google.

sources.title: Upgrade Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: Sign up free of charge by using your gmail account.

on_device_privacy.note: No on-device processing claim found on the help pages checked.

account_required.detail: Requires a Google (personal, Workspace or Education) account.

sources.title: Upgrade Gemini Notebook - Gemini Notebook Help
sources.quote: Sign up free of charge by using your gmail account.
